title: Bandai Namco's own Fact Book 2026: TEKKEN leads its home console game series by cumulative shipments (62.70M, to March 2026)
game: TEKKEN, NARUTO, DARK SOULS, Tales of, LITTLE NIGHTMARES (series)
why: Evergreen bank piece (numbers). DATES IT: Bandai Namco's Fact Book is yearly (FY ends March; the 2026 edition is dated 28 Oct 2026, figures to March 2026); the next edition (Fact Book 2027, about autumn 2027) updates it.

sources.name: Bandai Namco Group, FACT BOOK 2026 (English PDF), section 'Major home console game titles: Cumulative total number of shipments by series (including PC versions)', figures to March 2026

first_report: Bandai Namco Fact Book 2026 PDF (file creation date 28 Oct 2026), fetched through the normal fetch tool and its text extracted locally on 8 Nov 2026 about 17:45Z. Evergreen.
footage: Our graphics (numbers): Steam library art of Bandai Namco's own titles for each series, ending on two official TEKKEN 8 Steam screenshots (1920x1080). No single footage covers five series. Sources tried first: Square Enix IR (no per-title or five-franchise table readable: only FINAL FANTASY, DRAGON QUEST and KINGDOM HEARTS figures at different as-of dates; the Q1 PDF is encrypted-text but readable, the million-seller page redirects away), Sega Sammy IR (series figures at mixed fiscal years, no single ranking).

claims.text: TEKKEN series: cumulative total number of shipments, March 1995 to March 2026, 62.70 million units
NARUTO-related series: April 2006 to March 2026, 46.58 million units

DARK SOULS series: September 2011 to March 2026, 41.80 million units. Note: total for overseas sales for which Bandai Namco Entertainment Inc. was the original seller (excluding domestic sales by FromSoftware, Inc.)

Tales of... series: December 1995 to March 2026, 32.13 million units; LITTLE NIGHTMARES series: April 2017 to March 2026, 24.54 million units; Super Robot Wars series: April 1991 to March 2026, 21.33 million units (sixth, not shown)
Heading: 'Major home console game titles: Cumulative total number of shipments by series (including PC versions)'. The Reel uses the word shipments (شحنات) as Bandai Namco does
The list is the Fact Book's table of major series, not every series Bandai Namco owns; the Reel says 'among the major series listed' and never 'biggest of all'
Note on the page after LITTLE NIGHTMARES: 'Includes Network contents' (placement ambiguous in the extracted text), not claimed either way

gate: gate 17:50Z: Fact Book 2026 fetched (WebFetch saved the PDF), text extracted with pdftotext, the series block read line by line; nothing spoofed. Exit A for what is on screen.
